issues.title: Guide: Agent Operating Guide
issues.description:
## Objective
Create the operating guide for this expanded-mode dogfood project.

## Background Context
This project is not a static research plan. Linear is the control plane, the companion ledger is durable execution memory, and local docs preserve source-backed research and decisions.

## Required Reading
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/README.md
- ../.codex-linear-ledgers/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/EXECUTION.md
- SKILL.md
- references/expanded-mode.md
- references/execution-hygiene.md

## Operating Rules
- Direct Linear API is primary whenever credentials exist.
- MCP is the immediate fallback when API execution blocks, is unavailable, is unimplemented, or fails read-back.
- Coordinator owns Linear state, ledger state, dependency map, release metadata, installed runtime sync, and final verification.
- Research findings become Linear issues, sub-issues, decisions, or local docs.
- Expanded mode must remain opt-in.

## First Safe Execution Order
1. Build and read back the Linear graph.
2. Run parallel research dossiers.
3. Synthesize harness principles and project decisions.
4. Implement the API/MCP fallback contract hardening.
5. Add recursive loop and sensor/evaluator behavior.
6. Run deterministic and inferential sensors.
7. Install runtime after source verification.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Guide exists in Linear.
- Ledger points to this guide.
- First safe issue and coordinator-owned state are explicit.

## Verification
Read back issue, project, and ledger references.

issues.title: Guide: Verification Matrix And Sensor Stack
issues.description:

issues.title: Guide: Dependency Map And Safe Parallelism

issues.title: Research: OpenAI Symphony control-plane and scheduler model
issues.description:
## Objective
Produce a source-backed dossier on Symphony as a Linear-backed control plane, scheduler, runner, workspace lifecycle, state machine, and proof-of-work surface.

## Required Sources
- OpenAI Symphony article
- OpenAI Symphony repository
- OpenAI Symphony SPEC.md

## Outputs
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/research/symphony-control-plane.md
- Follow-up issue candidates for gaps between Symphony and this skill.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Separate facts, inferences, recommendations, and refresh triggers.
- Identify which Symphony ideas should become skill guidance, CLI behavior, templates, or future tool surfaces.
- Include implications for Linear issue state, blockers, isolated workspaces, retries, read-back, and proof of work.

## Verification
Dossier cites the provided sources and produces at least one concrete implementation recommendation.

issues.title: Research: Harness engineering guides, sensors, and steering loops
issues.description:
## Objective

## Required Sources
- Thoughtworks/Fowler Harness Engineering article
- OpenAI Harness Engineering article

## Outputs
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/research/harness-guides-sensors.md

## Verification

issues.title: Research: Ralph Wiggum and auto-research loop design
issues.description:
## Objective
Design the recursive loop pattern for this skill: Ralph Wiggum loops for repeated agent review and auto-research loops for repeated measurable improvement.

## Required Sources
- OpenAI Harness Engineering article section on repeated agent review loops.
- Local autoresearch skill contract.
- This repo's validation mode and evaluator files.

## Outputs
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/research/recursive-loop-design.md
- A proposed frozen evaluator set for the final loop.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Distinguish brute-force review loops from metric-driven auto-research loops.
- Define when to create new issues/sub-issues from misses.
- Preserve frozen evaluator principles.
- Avoid making long-horizon recursion mandatory for baseline projects.

## Verification
Research output includes a loop diagram or step list and maps each loop phase to Linear issue state.

issues.title: Research: Linear API primary with MCP fallback semantics
issues.description:
## Objective
Research and specify the exact hard rule: direct Linear API is primary; MCP is the fallback whenever API execution is unavailable, blocked, unimplemented, or fails read-back.

## Required Sources
- Current SKILL.md Linear Transition Wrapper and Live API Mode sections.
- references/execution-hygiene.md
- references/command-schemas.md
- lib/linear_agent/graphql.py and cli.py behavior.

## Outputs
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/decisions/api-primary-mcp-fallback.md
- Concrete implementation checklist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define block conditions.
- Define fallback order and read-back requirements.
- Identify source files to change.
- Identify tests/evaluators to update.

## Verification
Decision note names the exact wording to add or update in skill surfaces.

issues.title: Synthesis: Outer harness principles and project decision surface
issues.description:
## Objective
Synthesize the research dossiers into project principles, tradeoff rules, anti-goals, and implementation decisions.

## Outputs
- docs/expanded-mode/linear-skill-outer-harness-upgrade/decisions/outer-harness-principles.md
- Updated dependency map if sequencing changes.
- Follow-up issues for any missing work discovered by the synthesis.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every accepted principle has source or repo evidence.
- Recommendations are assigned to SKILL.md, references, templates, CLI, tests, docs, or future work.
- Baseline contamination risks are explicitly handled.

## Verification
A future agent can use the decision document to decide whether a proposed skill change belongs in baseline mode, expanded mode, CLI/tooling, or docs.

issues.title: Implement hard API-primary and MCP fallback rule across skill surfaces
issues.description:
## Objective
Make API-primary/MCP-fallback a hard skill rule rather than soft wording.

## Owned Scope
- SKILL.md Linear Transition Wrapper and Live API Mode wording.
- Relevant references and evaluator expectations.
- Tests/fixtures that assert the contract.

## Non-Owned Scope
- Do not rewrite baseline mode into expanded mode.
- Do not manually edit the installed runtime copy.
- Do not change secret storage.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The skill says API must be attempted first whenever credentials are available.
- The skill says MCP fallback must be used whenever API execution is unavailable, blocked, unimplemented, or fails read-back.
- Fallback attempts and evidence must be recorded in Linear/ledger.
- Evaluators catch regressions in this wording.

## Verification
Run front-door/audit evaluators plus the relevant unit tests.

issues.title: Implement recursive research-to-issue loop guidance
issues.description:
## Objective
Add explicit expanded-mode guidance for recursive project execution: research findings create issues, implementation triggers sensors, misses create follow-up issues, and the loop returns to research synthesis.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The loop is described without making deep recursion mandatory for baseline projects.
- Continuous Issue Discovery is tied to research, implementation, review, verification, docs, release, and handoff.
- Ledger template supports loop pass tracking.

## Verification
Run relevant evaluators and inspect the ledger template.

issues.title: Implement deterministic and inferential sensor matrix
issues.description:
## Objective
Make the skill's verification model read like an outer-harness sensor stack: deterministic computational sensors first, inferential sensors as review/judge passes, and final evidence recorded in Linear/ledger.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Deterministic sensors are explicit and repo-specific.
- Inferential sensors are explicit but bounded.
- The verification matrix explains when a failed sensor creates a new issue.
- Evaluators check for sensor language.

## Verification
Run evaluator tools and standard test suite subset.

issues.title: Dogfood loop pass: apply research, run checks, discover follow-ups
issues.description:
## Objective
Run at least one full recursive pass after implementation: compare the skill against research docs, run deterministic checks, perform inferential review, create follow-up issues for misses, and loop until no high-priority miss remains.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Dogfood note records pass inputs, changed files, checks, findings, follow-up issues, and next pass decision.
- Any missed requirement becomes a Linear issue or documented non-issue.
- No issue is marked Done before verification evidence exists.

## Verification
Check dogfood note, ledger, Linear issue states, and test/evaluator outputs.

issues.title: Release readiness, installed runtime sync, and final reconciliation
issues.description:
## Objective
Finish only when source repo verification, Linear read-back, ledger reconciliation, installed runtime sync, and release readiness agree.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Standard verification suite has run or skipped checks are explicitly justified.
- Runtime changes are installed with ./install.sh --with-docs and verified with ./install.sh --check.
- Linear project has completion evidence and no unresolved required issues.
- Release/publish path is followed if public release is in scope.

## Verification
Run final verification, install check, Linear read-back, and ledger reconciliation.
